verdict.rationale: Buzz gives each agent its own Nostr keypair, minted per agent with `buzz-admin generate-key` and enrolled via `add-member`. Each agent also has its own channel memberships and audit trail. NIP-AA ties agent access to the owner's membership, so revoking the owner automatically cuts off the agent, and a community commenter confirms channel-based scoping exists. However, the scoping is identity plus channel membership, not fine-grained API credential scopes, so it only partly meets the least-privilege ask. Missing for 10: per-credential permission scopes (e.g., read-only or action-limited keys), credential expiry/rotation, and an explicitly documented least-privilege grant flow for agent keys.
